title: SDKS/Docs/Quickstart Cohort Playbook & Initiative Operationalization
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create a repeatable, measurable cohort playbook that bundles SDKs, docs, and quickstarts into a single onramp experience for new developer cohorts. Purpose: reduce time-to-first-successful-request, increase 7-day activation conversion, and provide observability signals for devx OKRs. Playbook will include: (1) 3 starter SDK templates (Node, Python, Go) with sample apps; (2) a docs quickstart path (3 steps: install, first call, troubleshooting); (3) onboarding checklist for solutions engineers; (4) metrics dashboard and cohort tagging to feed the activation signal pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Starter SDK templates published in monorepo with CI and example apps (node/python/go)
Docs quickstart authored and live in docs.redwood.ai with step-by-step flows and code snippets
Cohort instrumentation implemented: tracking for time-to-first-successful-request, first-API-checkpoint, and 7-day retention
Playbook runbook for SEs published in Confluence with play-by-play checklist
A/B pilot with two cohorts shows >=15% improvement in time-to-first-successful-request or clear signal for next iteration
